title: Dirac Delta
subtitle: Special Functions · Distribution
summary: Generalised function defined by its action under integration.
detail:
\[ \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} f(x)\,\delta(x-a)\,dx = f(a) \]

Not a true function — a Schwartz distribution. The sifting property extracts the value of \(f\) at \(a\). \(\delta(x)=H'(x)\). The Fourier transform is \(\hat{\delta}=1\) (flat spectrum). Models point masses, point charges, and instantaneous impulses.
